FIELDS.NAME: Reliable Plumbing & HVAC Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Reliable Plumbing & HVAC Solutions specializes in providing high-quality plumbing and HVAC services for residential and light commercial clients. Our core operations include the installation, maintenance, and repair of heating systems, air conditioning units, and plumbing fixtures. We are committed to complying with all local, state, and federal safety and building regulations, ensuring that every job meets rigorous safety standards. Our team is composed of licensed professionals who undergo regular, documented training to stay updated on industry best practices and safety protocols. We prioritize customer satisfaction and safety by using high-quality materials and maintaining a clean, well-organized work environment. Our services focus on our expertise in plumbing and HVAC solutions.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 02/15/2023, we experienced a minor water damage incident during the installation of a new HVAC system at a residential property. The cause was an unexpected leak in the piping, which resulted in damages amounting to $500. The issue was promptly addressed, and repairs were completed within two days. Status: Resolved.
